tanya-cs: Quick sync 1: Novus Therapeutics renewal in 5 weeks. I ran the onboarding health report and saw two distinct latency excursions on their primary generate route that could trigger a credit under their contract. Need metrics + legal check before outreach. @liam-eng @ops-kai @ethan-legal

liam-eng: Can you paste the route? Also want to know if we apply the rolling 30d window or the quarter aggregate per contract.

tanya-cs: Route is /v1/predict/novus-main. Contract references the monthly measurement window (see SLA Appendix A) and latency SLA in Section 4.1 (p95 <= 750ms). Use the last 30 days per contract for credit calculation.

liam-eng: I'll pull the p95 and uptime for route-level only and exclude scheduled maints. Observability query I ran:
```
obs.query(
  metric="latency_p95",
  route="/v1/predict/novus-main",
  window="30d",
  exclude_windows=["2026-02-02T03:00Z/2026-02-02T04:00Z"]
)
```
That returns p95=910ms, uptime=99.65% (30d) for that route. Exported CSV to s3.

sre-bot: [system] Export complete: s3://redwood-evidence/novus/2849991234/novus_p95_30d.csv :white_check_mark:

ops-kai: FYI there was an autoscale-induced cold start spike on 2026-02-10 14:22 UTC that shows as a 12-minute tail-latency event. We documented mitigation (cache warmers + scaling dampening) in the incident note. Do we treat that as a customer-impact incident for the evidence bundle?

tanya-cs: Yes include it as an incident in the bundle. Customers want transparency and the contract says incidents are not automatically excluded.

ethan-legal: I'll need the precise clause to approve wording for the credit offer. Please confirm the contract month to bill against (is it the current invoice month?). Also check if the contract caps credits to 50% of monthly fees.

liam-eng: Confirmed: p95=910ms against SLA 750ms. Uptime 99.65% vs SLA 99.9%. Monthly commit (3-month avg) is $24,000. I ran our internal credit script (engineered_credit_v2) and got a raw credit fraction = (SLO_pct - observed_pct)/SLO_pct = (99.9 - 99.65)/99.9 = 0.0025. Raw credit = 24000 * 0.0025 = $60. But the contract uses discrete tiers: 0-0.1% -> $0, 0.1-0.5% -> $50, 0.5-1.0% -> $250, >1% -> 50% monthly fee. So result maps to $50.

tanya-cs: Good. Can you add the incident timeline and traces to the evidence bundle and upload? I also want a short remediation offer: two options for the customer (apply $50 credit or trial reserved capacity 14 days at no charge).

liam-eng: Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/novus/2849991234/evidence_bundle_v1.zip. It contains novus_p95_30d.csv, incident_timeline.md, and sample_traces_200.json.

sre-bot: [system] Upload complete: s3://redwood-evidence/novus/2849991234/evidence_bundle_v1.zip :white_check_mark:

ethan-legal: I reviewed Section 4.1 and the credit tiers. Approve customer-facing language that states: "Per Appendix A (Service Levels), Novus observed performance below the p95 latency target. Per the contractual credit tiers, a one-time credit of $50 is due. The credit will be applied to the next invoice unless you request otherwise." Include the evidence bundle link.

ops-kai: Ops supports the 14-day reserved-capacity trial if CS wants to offer remediation. We'll need a short runbook for the trial and a capacity allocation ticket. If they accept, we'll provision N3 reserved pool for 14 days and monitor.

tanya-cs: Draft email for Novus (please review & shorten):
"Hi Novus team, we completed a review of the last 30 days for route /v1/predict/novus-main. Observed p95 latency was 910ms (SLA: 750ms) and uptime 99.65% (SLA: 99.9%). Attached is an evidence bundle with metrics and trace samples. Per Appendix A of your agreement, this maps to a one-time credit of $50. As a remediation option we can also provision a 14-day reserved-capacity trial to reduce peak latency. Let us know which you prefer and whether to apply the credit to your next invoice."

liam-eng: Suggest tightening: remove passive phrasing and add the S3 link inline. I'll run a quick final QA on the CSV and send to Legal for sign-off.

ethan-legal: Approved. No extra clauses required. Also confirm we should cap the credit per the contract (50% cap) and this case is well below that.

ops-kai: I'll open capacity ticket if customer chooses trial: CAP-284999-NT. Ops will attach monitoring dash and alert thresholds.

liam-eng: Final QA done. Evidence bundle checksum: md5=9b7c4f2d.

tanya-cs: Thanks team. Actions: liam upload final QA note and circulate to Legal, eth an sign-off done, ops prepare runbook if trial accepted. I'll send the customer note after Legal ok and record the credit in CRM. Meeting to confirm outreach: Thu 10:00 PST. :calendar:
